headline: Cl0p affiliates chain unauthenticated flaws in internet-exposed PTC Windchill and FlexPLM servers as industrial and enterprise software draw fresh remote-code-execution attacks.

emerging_trends.text: Extortion crews keep chaining pre-authentication flaws in internet-exposed enterprise software, with Cl0p affiliates turning PTC Windchill and FlexPLM deployments into fresh data-theft targets.
emerging_trends.topic_title: Cl0p Extortion Campaign Chains Windchill and FlexPLM Flaws

emerging_trends.text: Industrial control vendors face a widening stream of code-execution bugs, as Rockwell Automation patches flaws in its Arena Simulation software that a researcher shows could reach manufacturing plants.
emerging_trends.topic_title: Rockwell Patches Arena Simulation Code-Execution Flaws

emerging_trends.text: Phishing operators are collapsing the gap between stealing a credential and using it, moving to real-time account hijacking against insurance customers.
emerging_trends.topic_title: Insurance Phishing Shifts to Real-Time Account Hijacking

topics.title: ServiceNow Pre-Auth RCE Exploited in the Wild
topics.latest_developments: Help Net Security's July 26, 2026 week-in-review flagged attackers exploiting a pre-authentication remote-code-execution flaw in ServiceNow's enterprise workflow platform in the wild.
topics.summary: ServiceNow, the widely deployed workflow and IT-service-management platform, carries a pre-authentication remote-code-execution flaw that attackers are actively exploiting; administrators should apply available fixes and hunt for compromise.

sources.title: Week in review: ServiceNow pre-auth RCE exploited in the wild, Hugging Face breached

topics.title: Attackers Scan for ESAFENET CDG Weak Logins
topics.latest_developments: The SANS Internet Storm Center reported on July 26, 2026 renewed scanning for ESAFENET's CDG document-management system, probing for SQL injection, cross-site scripting, and default passwords.
topics.summary: ESAFENET's CDG (Content Data Guard), a Chinese-market data-leakage-prevention and secure document product, carries basic flaws including SQL injection and default credentials that scanners are hunting; operators should change defaults and restrict internet exposure.

sources.title: Scans for ESAFENET CDG 3 Document Management System Weak Logins, (Sun, Jul 26th)

topics.title: Cl0p Extortion Campaign Chains Windchill and FlexPLM Flaws
topics.latest_developments: The Hacker News detailed on July 25, 2026 that Cl0p affiliates chain a pre-authentication information-disclosure flaw in the FlexPLM WSDL endpoint with a server-side flaw in the Windchill login servlet to run code without authentication.
topics.summary: Cl0p—also tracked as Chubby Scorpius, FIN11, Graceful Spider, and Lace Tempest—is stealing data from internet-exposed PTC Windchill and FlexPLM product-lifecycle-management systems for extortion; operators should pull these instances off the public internet and patch.

sources.title: Cl0p Affiliates Target Internet-Exposed PTC Windchill and FlexPLM with Unauthenticated RCE

topics.title: Insurance Phishing Shifts to Real-Time Account Hijacking
topics.latest_developments: CTM360 reported on July 25, 2026 that insurance-focused phishing operations now hijack accounts in real time, relaying a victim's stolen credentials and one-time codes to the attacker the moment the victim enters them.
topics.summary: Phishing crews targeting insurance customers now run live account takeover, passing credentials and multi-factor codes to attackers as victims type them; defenders should adopt phishing-resistant multi-factor authentication.

sources.title: CTM360 Research Reveals How Insurance Phishing Has Evolved Into Real-Time Account Hijacking

topics.title: Rockwell Patches Arena Simulation Code-Execution Flaws
topics.latest_developments: Rockwell Automation patched code-execution vulnerabilities in its Arena Simulation software on July 25, 2026, after a researcher showed how an attacker could exploit them to target industrial organizations.
topics.summary: Arena Simulation, Rockwell's discrete-event modeling tool that manufacturers use to plan operations, contained flaws that let an attacker run code; industrial users should update to the fixed release.

sources.title: Rockwell Patches Code Execution Flaws in Arena Simulation Software

business_politics.title: U.S. Pauses Iran Strikes as Mediators Chase Hormuz Deal
business_politics.latest_developments: The United States held off attacks for a second straight day and Iran reciprocated, while Oman pushed talks on a Strait of Hormuz transit deal and Pentagon officials weighed dwindling American air-defense stocks.
business_politics.summary: After nearly two weeks of intensifying bombing, President Trump shelved a campaign that officials said could have run two weeks, as mediators worked to steer the United States and Iran back toward an interim ceasefire and to calm oil markets rattled by threats to Gulf shipping and a collapsing Yemen truce.

around_town.title: County Jail Tests Water for Legionella
around_town.latest_developments: The Allegheny County Jail began sampling its water system after concerns about legionella in two officer bathrooms, and officials said no one has fallen ill.
around_town.summary: The Allegheny County Jail is testing its water to determine whether legionella bacteria reached two officer bathrooms; officials reported no known illnesses.

sources.title: Allegheny County Jail testing 2 officer bathrooms for potential legionella; no known illnesses

around_town.latest_developments: House Democratic leader Hakeem Jeffries launched the party's 100-days-to-the-midterms drive from a stage in battleground Pennsylvania, built around an affordability agenda.
around_town.summary: House Minority Leader Hakeem Jeffries chose Pennsylvania to open Democrats' campaign for control of the U.S. House in the November midterm elections, pressing a message centered on the cost of living.

around_teams.title: Cherington Signals Openness at Trade Deadline
around_teams.latest_developments: Pirates general manager Ben Cherington told the Post-Gazette on July 26 the club will stay 'open-minded' as the Major League Baseball trade deadline nears, flagging the bullpen as the clearest need.
around_teams.summary: Ben Cherington said Pittsburgh plans to weigh moves in both directions before the deadline, with a bullpen battered by injuries the area most likely to see additions.

sources.title: As the trade deadline nears, Ben Cherington says the Pirates plan to be 'open-minded' on moves

around_teams.title: Pirates Sign Top Pick Derek Curiel
around_teams.latest_developments: The Pirates officially signed outfielder Derek Curiel, the fifth overall pick in the 2026 draft, who said he is eager to 'make an impact.'
around_teams.summary: Pittsburgh added outfielder Derek Curiel, its first-round selection and the fifth choice overall in the 2026 First-Year Player Draft, bringing a highly rated bat into the farm system.

sources.title: After officially signing with the Pirates, first rounder Derek Curiel is excited to 'make an impact'
